sheets.title: TITLE SHEET
sheets.reading_notes: Project title: Office and Warehouse Facility for Blackwater Electric. Architect of record: RRMM Architects, PC, 1317 Executive Blvd Suite 200, Chesapeake VA 23320 (757-622-2828). Civil: Timmons Group, Virginia Beach VA. Structural: Broyles and Associates, 508 Baylor Ct Suite C, Chesapeake VA 23320. Owner: Blackwater Electric, 807 Professional Place West, Chesapeake VA 23320, 757-549-9422. Contact: David Hart, db@blackwaterelectric.com. Sheet index spans Civil (C0.0–L2.0), Structural (S-001–S-402), Architectural (A-001–A-801). Only 4 civil/cover sheets present in this PDF. Perspective rendering shown: two-story office building with metal panel/masonry exterior, attached single-story warehouse. Volume 1 of 1 noted.

sheets.title: COVER SHEET (Civil)
sheets.reading_notes: Site data: Property Address 400 Network Station, Chesapeake VA 23320. Parcel 0482010000240 (M.B. 152, P. 129). Zoning PUD. Existing use: Commercial-Vacant. Proposed use: Office Building. Max building height: 75 ft. City water and sewer available. No wetlands within project limits. Flood zone 'X' per Map 51003C4030D, December 15, 2014. Total site area 144,305 SF (3.31 AC). Total building footprint 16,551 SF: office 10,963 SF, warehouse 5,588 SF. Future expansion noted: 6,286 SF. Total impervious with expansion: 61,440 SF (1.41 AC). Disturbed area: 112,285 SF (2.58 AC). Parking required: 72; provided: 76 total (4 handicapped, 2 van accessible). BMP data: private only, allowable C=0.75, designed C=0.53 without expansion / 0.56 with expansion. AC# 194109_00 (City of Chesapeake permit). Engineer: Timmons Group, John Zaszewski PE. Architect: RRMM Architects PC, Josh Gerloff. Surveyor: Timmons Group, Eric Patterson LS. Civil cover sheet for permit set dated 09/18/2019.

sheets.title: GENERAL NOTES
sheets.reading_notes: City of Chesapeake general construction notes and demolition/drainage/utility notes. Confirms jurisdiction: City of Chesapeake, VA. References VDOT Road Design Manual (2007) and Hampton Roads Planning District Commission (HRPDC) regional standards. Notes reference storm drainage structures sized per Chesapeake BMP standards. General contractor obligations for as-built drawings. Referenced topographic notes. Fire hydrant requirements: NFPA 291.

sheets.title: EXISTING CONDITIONS
sheets.reading_notes: Topographic survey / existing conditions plan. Field survey by Mid-Atlantic Surveying and Land Design, June 26, 2019. Scale 1'=100'. Shows site boundaries, adjacent parcels (Industrial Development Authority and others), wetland buffers (52' wetland buffer shown twice on north edge), easements, setbacks. Front parking setback 25', rear building setback 15', side building setback 15'. Key adjacent parcels: Network Station LLC (parcel 0482010000023), several Industrial Development Authority parcels. Survey certification signed by Beth Anne G. Campbell PE/LS, dated 06-25-2019. Topographic benchmark reference: City of Chesapeake geodetic control network, NAVD88. Topography shows relatively flat site with slight grade changes.

sheets.title: MECHANICAL NOTES AND DETAILS
sheets.reading_notes: Mechanical details sheet for VRF/ductless split system. Designer: Elizabeth River Mechanical / Infinity Design Group (IDG), 758 Thimble Shoals Blvd Suite 804, Newport News VA 23606, (757) 877-9033. Drawn by WHL, checked by WHL. Project No. 19-142. Date 2/18/20. PROGRESS PRINT stamp — not for construction. System types shown: wall-mounted ductless AHU (split system/VRF), RTU condensate trap, intake louver, wall exhaust fan, ductwork diffuser/return grille details. Legend: condensate drain, refrigerant suction, refrigerant liquid, natural gas. Mechanical abbreviations include VRF. General notes reference 2015 Virginia Mechanical Code and 2012 International Energy Code. Equipment tag format: AHU-2/WAITING ROOM/5 TON. Gas meter demand schedule: RTU-1=150 MBH, UH-1=200, UH-2=200, UH-3=200, UH-4=200, Water Heater=N/A (Electric), Future=300; Total=1,250 MBH. Natural gas service for unit heaters (warehouse).

sheets.title: MECHANICAL FIRST FLOOR PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Scale 1/8"=1'-0". Shows VRF outdoor unit layout (OU-1 through multiple outdoor units on roof), wall-mounted ductless AHU units throughout office spaces on first floor. Unit heater symbols (UH-1, UH-2) in warehouse area. Gas meter on exterior. Supply plenum 16/12 in common area corridor. Ductwork routing (flex duct) to diffusers per schedule. AHU tags identify individual room assignments and tonnage (e.g., AHU-1-5 at various sizes, AHU-2 series). Multiple branch refrigerant lines to ductless units. Gas piping routing from meter to unit heaters. Swing joints at gas connections. First floor shows both the large open-plan office and the attached warehouse. PROGRESS PRINT stamp.

sheets.title: MECHANICAL SECOND FLOOR PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Scale 1/8"=1'-0". Second floor (mezzanine level over office portion). AHU-3 series units shown for second floor offices. Gas piping routing 20/10 up to RTU-1 and/or mezzanine. RTU-1 referenced (150 MBH gas — this may be a rooftop unit for common areas). Refrigerant piping routed up to outdoor units. Notes: 'DUCT CHASE' labeled for vertical routing between floors. Warehouse section is single story — no second floor over warehouse on this plan. Common area AHU detail shown. PROGRESS PRINT stamp. Gas Piping Notes: all gas piping shall be Schedule 40 black steel pipe; pressure regulators gas-operated 5 lbs. with vent limiter.

sheets.title: LEGEND, ABBREVIATIONS AND GENERAL NOTES
sheets.reading_notes: Electrical legend, abbreviations, and 11 general notes. Engineer: Bowman Foster & Associates, 6203 Sun Dr #301 (likely Richmond VA). Architect of record: RRMM Architects PC. Project 19/43-00, dated 3/9/2020. Notes: per UFC, NEC, and local jurisdiction. Circuitry is diagrammatic. Conduit in concrete slabs to be in middle third. All new work concealed in ceilings/walls. General contractor responsibilities for coordination. Mechanical room/electrical room lighting to be provided with fixtures coordinated with trade. Legend shows: disconnect switch 240V NEMA 1, electrical panelboard (20BY/120V), manual transfer switch (MTS), homeruns to panel with circuit designation.

sheets.title: ELECTRICAL FIRST FLOOR PLAN — NEW WORK
sheets.reading_notes: Scale 1/8"=1'-0". First floor electrical new work. Panelboards shown: Panel A1 (labeled), Panel B1 (labeled), Panel MOP (labeled). 400A GEN 'TAP BOX' shown — suggests generator connection point or meter CT cabinet nearby. Meter/CT cabinet called out. Unit heater connections UH-1 and UH-2 in warehouse area (2P-30A feeds). Multiple AHU connections throughout first floor (2P-20A and 2P-30A feeds). Branch circuit wiring to AHU units per VRF system. B1 circuits: B1-2 (2 #10 & 1 #10 GND - 3/4"C), B1-14,16, B1-18,20, B1-10. Note at top: CONNECT TO FIRST FLOOR LIGHTING CIRCUIT. Scale 1/8"=1'-0".

sheets.title: ELECTRICAL SECOND FLOOR AND ROOF PLAN — NEW WORK
sheets.reading_notes: Scale 1/8"=1'-0". Two plans on sheet: Second floor plan and roof plan. Second floor: AHU-3 series units (AHU-3-1 through AHU-3-5 approximately), panel B1 circuit feeds. Wall-mounted outdoor unit module connections (OU-1, OU-2). Roof plan: shows RTU-1, HF-1 (heat/exhaust fan), OU-1 and OU-2 (outdoor VRF units). RTU-1 feed: 3P 60A NEMA 3R disconnect, B1-29 (4 #3 & 1 #8 GND-3/4"C) and B1-17 (4 #5 & 1 #8 GND-1"C). OU-1/OU-2: 3P 60A NEMA 3R disconnects, circuits from Panel B1. HF-1: 2P-20, B1-6. Note: CONNECT TO SECOND FLOOR LIGHTING CIRCUIT. Confirms 3-phase service for VRF outdoor units.
